_comment: Nocturna asset store catalog (D-13 locked schema). STAFF: add or edit products HERE — no code changes needed. Each product needs: id (unique), name{es,en}, description{es,en}, price (plain number string, NO $ — the site adds '$ … USD'), images[] (Jinxxy CDN URLs; images[0] is the card thumbnail), checkoutUrl (the PRIMARY Jinxxy listing — https:// only; this is the main 'Comprar en Jinxxy' button), editor (credited creator, plain text), category, nsfw (true blurs the card), featured (true pins it first + red badge), date (YYYY-MM-DD, newest shown first after featured). OPTIONAL long-form quick-view sections (each {es,en}, omit or leave empty to hide the section): license (usage terms), details (specs/formats), updates (changelog). Use \n inside these for line breaks. OPTIONAL storefronts (array): extra stores BESIDES the primary Jinxxy link — each entry is { "platform": "booth", "url": "https://…" } (https:// only). They render as extra 'Comprar en {platform}' buttons in the quick-view below the primary buttons; nothing extra shows if the array is absent/empty. Known platform display names (jinxxy, booth, gumroad, payhip) are pretty-printed automatically; any other platform key is title-cased. To add a store later, just append to a product's storefronts array — no code change. Example: "storefronts": [{ "platform": "booth", "url": "https://booth.pm/en/items/123" }]. Replace the example jinxxy-cdn.com URLs below with real listing images + links.
